<script>
/* Wall videos: honour reduced motion (poster only) and pause loops that are off screen. */
(function () {
  var vids = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.wall video'));
  if (!vids.length) return;
  var mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  var still = function () { vids.forEach(function (v) { v.removeAttribute('autoplay'); v.pause(); v.load(); }); };
  if (mq.matches) { still(); }
  if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change', function (e) { if (e.matches) still(); });
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
      es.forEach(function (e) {
        if (mq.matches) return;
        if (e.isIntersecting) { var p = e.target.play(); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () {}); } else { e.target.pause(); }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.15 });
    vids.forEach(function (v) { io.observe(v); });
  }
})();
</script>
